note: A strict build over register 1 (#1736). Variables 5, 6 and 7 share the source name 'Ägarnummer' and the operational definition 'Ägarens nummer', so the definition steps are skipped. Variable 7's column AGARE is its own: '(AGARE)'. Variables 5 and 6 spell one column AGNR and AgNr, equal case-folded, so each also takes its years; 6 has one year, written alone.
fails_if: the ladder lets a tie take the definition step (all three become 'Ägarnummer — Ägarens nummer' and are refused), compares columns case-sensitively (5 and 6 publish '(AGNR)' and '(AgNr)'), drops the year step (5 and 6 are refused as duplicate_variable_name) or writes a single year as a range

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers AGNR in 2000 and 2001, variable 6 AgNr in 2002 and variable 7 AGARE in 2002, all named 'Ägarnummer' with the operational definition 'Ägarens nummer'.
